CustomField.description: True once the earnest money wire has been sent, stamped from the group B checklist item. A NEW FIELD IS REQUIRED AND EM_Wired__c CANNOT BE REPURPOSED: EM_Wired__c is a formula TEXT field that renders Earnest_Money__c as a display string such as $1.5M, so it is neither boolean nor writable. Naming follows the Subject then PastParticiple boolean convention. Feeds the earnest-at-risk derivation together with Feasibility_Deadline__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the earnest money wire has actually been sent. Set from the checklist; do not edit directly.
CustomField.label: Earnest Money Sent
